metadata.title: Autentik | Industrial Technology Manufacturing in Indonesia
metadata.description: PT Autentik Karya Analitika develops technology products and systems for industry, laboratories, environmental monitoring, and IoT integration.

hero.companySubtitle: Indonesian manufacturer of industrial technology products.

aboutUs.description: AKA develops technology products and systems for industry, laboratories, and environmental monitoring. Our development process combines hardware engineering, IoT integration, and data processing so that each solution fits its users’ operational needs.

implementation.description: Deploying products for monitoring, laboratory, and environmental applications.

featured.description: Selected AKA products for monitoring, laboratories, and water treatment.

solutions.title: Product Development Capabilities

iot.title: IoT & Monitoring Development

laboratory.title: Laboratory Products & Systems
